scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Lhamo Auntie’s confirmed late-night Queens arrival able to move from taxi to apartment without relying on improvised sidewalk coordination.
Emerging Need: A tentative visit becomes a definite overnight welcome, then the building announces that after-hours guest entry during the repair week requires a pre-issued vestibule code.
Decision Context: Stored apartment-arrival notes identify the privacy-safe request channel, allowed details, and no-cost limit; observed records establish date, timing, and commitment.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves a necessary access prerequisite for the future welcome, while waiting past the desk cutoff leaves that prerequisite unavailable.

parameter.subject: Maybe Lhamo Auntie will pass through Queens
parameter.body: Lhamo Auntie may have a long New York stop on January 3, but Tashi is still checking whether he can host her that night. I should know more tomorrow, so please don’t rearrange anything yet.

parameter.content: Confirmed update: Tashi cannot host, so Lhamo Auntie will come to your apartment after her LaGuardia arrival on January 3. She lands at 8:45 p.m. and won’t have phone data, but I’ll give her your address card before she leaves.

parameter.title: Lhamo Auntie overnight welcome
parameter.description: Confirmed late arrival from LaGuardia, tea and snack welcome upstairs, overnight family hospitality.
Fruit, tea, and biscuits for the confirmed late-night overnight welcome.

parameter.subject: Jan. 1-7 vestibule guest-code cutoff
parameter.body: Reminder for residents expecting after-8 p.m. visitors during the January 1-7 lobby fob replacement: one-time vestibule guest-code requests must be received by 4:00 p.m. today. Codes will be prepared on December 30. Unregistered after-hours visitors cannot use the visitor lane during the repair week.

parameter.subject: Guest-code queue closed for Jan. 1-7 repair week
parameter.body: The front desk has closed the January 1-7 after-hours visitor-code queue as of 4:00 p.m. today. No additional one-time guest codes will be prepared for that repair week; residents should plan to meet any unregistered visitors outside the vestibule.
